VALLEY FOG SEA: a level white sea of fog filling the whole valley floor with the tops of two hills standing clear out of it
GROUND MIST IN HOLLOWS: a soft ground mist lying in the field hollows and low folds of the land far below
RIVER MIST POOLING: a pale mist pooling and drifting along the line of the river threading through the fields below
FOG THINNING IN PATCHES: the valley fog thinning in ragged patches here and there with glimpses of darker ground showing through
SOFT MIST LAYER BELOW: a thin soft mist layer sitting just below the vessel with the land dimly readable beneath it
FOG OVER THE SADDLE: valley fog spilling slowly over a low saddle between two hills and spreading into the next hollow
STILL SHARP HORIZON: still and sharp air with the far horizon crisp and sitting cleanly at the edge of the world
DRY CLEAR FIELD AIR: dry clear air with every field edge and hedge line readable far into the distance below
CLEAN COLD AIR: clean cold air pressing close around the vessel with a fine bright clarity reaching all the way to the ground
CLEAR AND CALM: clear calm air holding the vessel steady with the land below sitting sharp and fully open to the eye
BRIGHT DEEP CLEAR AIR: bright clear air with great depth, the view falling away far below with nothing to soften or interrupt it
PALE FAR HAZE ONLY: clear air all the way to the middle distance with a faint pale haze gathering only at the very far horizon
WARM DUSTY HAZE: a warm dusty haze softening the far distance into soft blurred tones while the near land stays readable
PALE SEA HAZE: a pale sea haze lying along the coastal edge of the view and softening the far shore into the air
THIN HIGH VEIL: a thin high veil spread evenly across the air softening everything gently and giving the whole view a quiet milky quality
SUMMER HEAT HAZE: a summer heat haze shimmering and rippling low over the fields in the distance far below the vessel
FINE GOLDEN DUST HAZE: a fine golden dust haze drifting through the air softening the middle distance into a warm amber blur
DRIFTING DRIZZLE VEIL: a soft grey veil of drizzle drifting slowly across one side of the view with the air beside it staying open
FINE RAIN MIDDLE DISTANCE: fine rain softening the middle distance into grey while the near fields below hold their shape and colour
DRIZZLE ON THE FAR HILLS: light drizzle blurring the far hills into a soft grey wash at the back of the view
PASSING RAIN VEIL: a passing veil of rain moving through one quarter of the view with clear open air sitting close beside it
STEADY BREEZE BELOW: a steady breeze combing the grass and crops in long slow waves across the fields far below the vessel
GUSTY LEANING AIR: a gusty air pressing unevenly against the vessel and leaning it gently to one side in small repeated nudges
CALM LEVEL AIR: calm still air with the vessel sitting level and settled and the air around it entirely unhurried
LIVELY TAUT AIR: lively moving air with ropes and pennants pulled out taut and streaming in a clean steady direction
